name: BPURI
recent: Bina Puri 在截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度录得净利 6,758 万令吉，主要来自一次性收益，营收同比下滑 49.6%。公司于 11 月 19 日召开第 34 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，并于 11 月 24 日公布多项企业提案。新闻显示公司正加大砂拉越业务布局，并寻求当地工程配套。
notable: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度录得净利 6,758 万令吉，营收 3,159 万令吉。
第 34 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 19 日举行，所有决议获股东通过。
2026 年 11 月 24 日公布多项企业提案。
risks: 2026 年 9 月 7 日公告涉及清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理事项。
2026 年 10 月 1 日有两名董事部成员变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度营收为 3,159 万令吉，环比下降 10.3%，同比下降 49.6%；净利为 6,758 万令吉，净利率 213.9%，去年同期净利率为 -26.6%。

recent_en: Bina Puri posted a net profit of RM67.58 million for the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, boosted by one-off gains, while revenue fell 49.6% year-on-year. The company held its 34th AGM on 19 Nov 2026 where all resolutions were passed, and announced multiple proposals on 24 Nov 2026. News indicates the company is deepening its Sarawak focus and pursuing local project packages.
notable_en: Recorded net profit of RM67.58 million on revenue of RM31.59 million for the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026.
All resolutions were passed at the 34th AGM held on 19 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Announcement on 7 Sep 2026 relates to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
Two boardroom changes were announced on 1 Oct 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was RM31.59 million, down 10.3% QoQ and 49.6% YoY; net profit was RM67.58 million with a net margin of 213.9%, compared with a net margin of -26.6% a year earlier.
